protocol.selection: First eight SHA256(sae-features-v1:<method>:<channel>) channels with activity fraction from 0.01 through 0.99. Three strongest activations on distinct speakers per channel.
protocol.timing: Latent hop 256 samples (16 ms), nominal center 256*t+128; encoder receptive field 1276 samples (79.75 ms). Acoustic proxies use 1024-sample Hann windows; boundary and RMS<1e-4 frames are excluded from correlations.
protocol.association: Descriptive Pearson r across pooled frames. Other proxies control linearly for log10 RMS; RMS correlation is unadjusted. Pitch uses autocorrelation confidence >=0.6 over 50-400 Hz. Per-speaker r and sign agreement are also saved. No p-values or confirmatory labels.
protocol.sample_format: Mono PCM16 WAV; metrics calculated after decoding these exact WAV bytes. No gain adjustment, normalization, alignment or resampling.
protocol.ablation: Set one selected channel to zero at all time steps. Decode full-utterance latents, then crop 1.024 s around the selected peak. Control uses the unchanged code. No re-encoding.
protocol.limits: All 40 speakers appeared in development. No independent speaker-held-out confirmation. No phoneme annotations. Channels are not matched across independently trained models. Selected peak examples are not representative average ablation effects.

l1.selection_rule: Minimum validation total loss including native penalties
